Game Overview

In Quevi, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Quevi's thrilling 2D sci-fi platformer world, where cunning agility is key. Navigate complex levels filled with enemy robots, airborne threats, and perilous traps. Master the art of double jumping, strategically collect metallic orbs, and discover power-ups for an edge in your relentless quest to the exit.
